color.$description: Colours that do not vary by theme.

alpha-tint.$description: The alpha a status colour is tinted to when it backs a container (a warning banner, a danger ghost button). Paired with the matching *-strong foreground, which is what keeps the label at AA; changing this alpha invalidates the measured ratios on those four tokens.

alpha-ambient-min.$description: Lower opacity bound for quiet ambient affordance motion.

alpha-ambient-max.$description: Upper opacity bound for quiet ambient affordance motion.
